description: fz-go4.18.12 finding 1 (dominant churn). A changed demand triggers invalidate_runtime_demand_dependents -> invalidate_demand_derived_products_one, which wipes dependents' memo entries UNCONDITIONALLY; they recompute to the same value. Measured (2x runs, 4 fixtures): RuntimeDemand re-productions byte-identical 58/65 (00181), 60/64 (00001), 13/15 (00026), 6/8 (escaped_callable); ExecutableEffects re-productions 100% identical (14/14, 21/21, 6/6, 5/5 — invalidate_artifact_products wipes them on every demand wobble). The equality check that exists (record_latest_runtime_demand) is used to START propagation but never to STOP it at unchanged hops. FIX: gate each propagation hop on the changed-check — an invalidation that recomputes to an identical value must not propagate further (monotone, semantics-preserving; this is memoization hygiene, not a lattice change). Locus: pull.rs invalidate_runtime_demand_dependents / invalidate_demand_derived_products_one / invalidate_artifact_products. ACCEPTANCE (minimal-job-trace doctrine): identical re-production counts drop to ~0 on the 4-fixture corpus; suite green 3x; job totals drop (00181 baseline 247).

comments.text:
STOP per stop-clause: the redundant wipes are LOAD-BEARING for convergence, not pure memoization slack. Findings (all measured on this branch, WIP patch preserved at /tmp/fz-go4.18.17-wip.patch, base 014aa505f):
(1) Pure wavefront gating (mark only the changed node's demand stale; propagate only on value change) LIVELOCKS: fz_f98_range_map_converges has a period-2 orbit — FunctionId(174)'s joined return demand flips Whole <-> TupleFields([Whole,Whole]) forever, driven by FunctionId(201)'s alternating contribution. Base terminates ONLY because its unconditional cone wipe removes both cycle members' demand memos SIMULTANEOUSLY, routing in-SCC reads through the fixed active-seed bootstrap (clamped values -> unchanged -> freeze). The freeze is a schedule-frozen state, not a monotone fixpoint.
(2) Narrower damping (SCC over runtime_demand_dependents only) MISCOMPILES the same fixture (backend value unbound at encode_call_args) — the frozen state goes inconsistent across products. The true demand dependency graph is reads UNION join-contributions, and in that graph EVERY caller-callee pair is a 2-cycle (caller contributes return demand to callee; caller reads callee's demand), so correct simultaneity-damping degenerates to marking essentially the whole connected call graph per join wobble: measured WORSE than base (00181 identical demand re-productions 110 vs base ~58; escaped_callable 18 vs ~6). Suite IS green in that configuration (922/0/28) and end products byte-identical, but the acceptance metric regresses.
(3) The ~0 target for RuntimeDemand identical re-productions is therefore BLOCKED on making the return-demand join iteration convergent by construction (fz-f98.14 / fz-go4.18.21 / fz-rh2 family). Until then, every join wobble must re-derive its feedback cone to keep the frozen state consistent.
(4) SALVAGEABLE INDEPENDENT WIN (proved on this branch): ExecutableEffects gating. Effects read only (local EffectSummary, local callee set) per materialized executable; gating effect-cone invalidation on that projection (session-side, in record_materialized_executable) drops identical effect re-productions 14/14, 21/21, 6/6, 5/5 -> 0/0/0/0 with the suite green — and it composes with BASE demand topology (it does not touch the demand loop). Recommend splitting that into its own ticket and re-scoping this one behind the join-convergence fix. Also reusable: ProductMemo displaced-value tracking + 'identical' measurement on pull.product.produced (the direct telemetry for this audit), and the facts-epoch (FactTable::epoch) for future demand memoization.
